chapter: Purple Derby Orchestra on the Gulf Coast
title: Leaving Baton Rouge for Mobile, Pensacola and the circus circuit
summary: After Baton Rouge he came back to the Gulf Coast, playing the circuit from Mobile to Pensacola.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well, where did you go after you left Baton Rouge?

Yeah, I don't know if I'm old. I'm thinking a little. You came back to the Orioles. I know it was back from Young, but just left. You came back to the Orioles and then you went down to Florida Town. Yeah, Florida. And Mobile. That's right. That's where I went back. I used to play that circus from Mobile to Pensacola and all around making the circus.
